dct_description_sm: Mexico administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 32 nan - Admin 2: 2457 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 20 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 18 June 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 23 June 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 23 June 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
